claude-mem v15.21.0 — your coding agent remembers between sessions

Install Commands (no Bun required):
  npx claude-mem                     Interactive install
  npx claude-mem install              Interactive install (also puts the claude-mem hook launcher on PATH)
  Installing for a user who is available? Run npx claude-mem install --setup browser and keep it running.
  User unavailable? Use --setup defer to leave their choices for the first visit to the web GUI.
  npx claude-mem install --setup browser|defer   Open web setup now, or save it for later (works from agent shells)
  npx claude-mem install --ide <id>   Install for specific IDE
  npx claude-mem install --ide dsh --dsh-profile <name>   Install DeepSeek Harness (default profile: web)
  npx claude-mem install --provider claude|codex|gemini|openrouter|host   Set LLM provider explicitly. Without install flags, agent shells save setup for the web GUI. codex, gemini and openrouter need a cmem.ai sign-in in a browser; claude and host need no claude-mem account
  npx claude-mem install --model <id>   Set Claude or Codex model (when provider=claude|codex)
  npx claude-mem install --no-auto-start   Skip worker auto-start at the end
  npx claude-mem install --disable-auto-memory   Explicitly disable Claude Code native auto-memory
  npx claude-mem install --runtime worker|server   Select runtime non-interactively (server prints the docker compose command for pg+redis without running it, and provisions a hook API key only when CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_DATABASE_URL is set; otherwise set CLAUDE_MEM_SERVER_DATABASE_URL before running npx claude-mem server keys rotate once Postgres is up)
  npx claude-mem install --runtime server --server-url <url>   Point the server runtime at a specific base URL
  npx claude-mem repair                Repair runtime (re-runs Bun/uv setup and bun install in plugin cache)
  npx claude-mem prune [--dry-run] [--keep <n>]   Remove superseded plugin cache versions (keeps newest 2 + live worker + registered install)
  npx claude-mem update               Update while keeping your setup; asks only for missing configuration
  npx claude-mem uninstall            Remove plugin, configs and the hook launcher
  npx claude-mem version              Print version

Runtime Commands (requires Bun, delegates to installed plugin):
  npx claude-mem start                Start worker service
  npx claude-mem stop                 Stop worker service
  npx claude-mem restart              Restart worker service
  npx claude-mem status               Show worker status
  npx claude-mem doctor               Diagnose install/runtime health (bun, uv, hook launcher, worker)
  npx claude-mem telemetry status|enable|disable   Manage anonymous telemetry (on by default, opt-out)
  npx claude-mem server start         Start server service
  npx claude-mem server stop          Stop server service
  npx claude-mem server restart       Restart server service
  npx claude-mem server status        Show server status
  npx claude-mem server api-key create|list|revoke   Manage API keys
  npx claude-mem worker start|stop|restart|status    Worker compatibility aliases
  npx claude-mem search <query>       Search observations
  npx claude-mem mcp                    Start the stdio MCP server
  npx claude-mem hook cursor <event>    Run Cursor hook forwarding
  npx claude-mem adopt [--dry-run] [--branch <name>]    Stamp merged worktrees into parent project
  npx claude-mem cleanup [--dry-run]    Run one-time v12.4.3 pollution cleanup (or preview counts)
  npx claude-mem project merge <from> <into> [--dry-run]    Fold one project's memory into another (non-destructive, syncs)
  npx claude-mem backup run|status|list   Manage local DB snapshots
  npx claude-mem restore <file>       Restore the DB from a snapshot
  npx claude-mem import --from mem0 --source-account <label> --user <id> --project <name>   Import Mem0 memories (MEM0_API_KEY)
  npx claude-mem import --from supermemory --source-account <label> --namespace <id> --project <name>   Import Supermemory memories (SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY); add --documents for source text, --platform <host> for a host other than Claude Code, or --dry-run to preview
  npx claude-mem transcript watch     Start transcript watcher
  npx claude-mem memory ingest [--source <dir> | --all] [--dry-run] [--require-cwd]   Import Claude Code auto-memory notes as observations
  npx claude-mem antigravity-cli install|status|uninstall   Manage Antigravity CLI hooks + MCP config
  npx claude-mem kimi install|status|uninstall   Manage Kimi Code CLI hooks + MCP config
  npx claude-mem hermes install --mcp-only --project-cwd <absolute-directory>   Connect Hermes MCP without selecting a memory provider
  npx claude-mem hermes uninstall   Remove the owned Hermes integration; keep other settings and memories
  npx claude-mem aider install|status|uninstall|sync   Manage Aider file-based context
  npx claude-mem gemini install|status|uninstall   Manage Gemini CLI capture hooks
  npx claude-mem devin install|status|uninstall   Manage Devin CLI / Devin Desktop hooks + MCP
  npx claude-mem t3code status|uninstall [--settings <path>]   Inspect or disable T3 Code provider plugins
  npx claude-mem pi install|status|uninstall   Manage the native Pi extension
  npx claude-mem grok install|status|uninstall   Load recalled memory into Grok Build sessions (current folder)

TeamBrain (one shared brain for your team; your own memory stays private):
  npx claude-mem teambrain start                Create a team on cmem.ai
  npx claude-mem teambrain join <invite-link>   Join a team, then choose which projects to share
  npx claude-mem teambrain status|share|leave   Check your teams, change what you share, or leave

Claude Code Hooks:
  Each hook runs claude-mem hook claude-code <event> directly, with no shell.
  That claude-mem is a small launcher the installer places on PATH:
  ~/.local/bin (macOS/Linux) or %LOCALAPPDATA%\claude-mem\bin (Windows).
  Hook error 'Executable not found in $PATH: "claude-mem"'? Run npx claude-mem install,
  restart your terminal or IDE, then check npx claude-mem doctor.

Agent IDs (for --ide):
  claude-code, cursor, grok-bot, opencode, openclaw, omp, hermes, pi, dsh,
  windsurf, codex-cli, t3code (aliases: t3, t3-code), kimi, devin, copilot-cli, copilot-vscode, antigravity, goose,
  roo-code, warp, zed
